description:
Rock and Mineral Specimen Lot - 15 Pieces
Geological Study Collection
Educational Earth Science Specimens
This collection features 15 varied rock and mineral specimens housed in an organized molded compartmental tray with an exterior textured red storage box. Educational rock and mineral kits of this type were commonly assembled for geology students and hobbyists to study crystal habits, streak, luster, and cleavage.
Items Included:
15 varied geological specimens including sulfur, quartz, fluorite, feldspar, and metallic ore samples
Individual numbered identification stickers affixed to multiple specimens
15-compartment white molded plastic display tray
Two-piece textured maroon red paperboard storage box
Condition:
Natural geological specimens show expected raw crystalline and fractured surfaces. Several specimens retain circular numbered collection labels with minor adhesive aging. Storage box displays light exterior corner rubbing and shelf wear, remaining structurally sound.
Thank you for all of your support!
SHIPPING
-
ORDERS ARE SHIPPED VIA FEDEX OR USPS GROUND ADVANTAGE.
Orders are shipped at a one pound minimum. Due to Dimensional Sizing customers MUST contact seller, prior to making payment, if wanting to combine items into one order. All items ship within 5 BUSINESS days, not including weekends and holidays. Rejected/undeliverable shipments and returns will be considered a donation to our agency.
**All orders over $500 will require an indirect signature. All orders over $1000 will require a DIRECT signature. Please make arrangements accordingly.**
COMBINING ORDERS
- If you wish to combine items, please contact seller before processing your items for payment.
RETURNS
- Please read descriptions and view photos carefully prior to bidding. ALL items are sold "AS IS" with all sales being final. Bids are placed with the knowledge that items are used and/or old and may contain unseen faults that the seller is not responsible for. By bidding on items, the buyer understands and accepts that items are represented, through description and pictures to the best of our ability. Items are untested nor have they been authenticated unless otherwise specified.
NON-PAYMENT
- Items not paid for by the deadline date will be relisted the next business day unless customer requests an extension prior to deadline date.
PAYMENT -
We accept Visa, MasterCard & PayPal. We do NOT accept personal checks or money orders. Thank you for supporting the Akron Goodwill Mission. Good luck and happy bidding.

shipping.policy:
We are NOT responsible for packages lost, stolen, or damaged in transit. You will need to handle your own claims through the associated shipping carrier. We can provide necessary documentation if requested.
Items from our location will ship within 5-7 business days from the time payment is received. Our hours of operation are Monday through Friday from approximately 7am-3pm EST.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
All other items may be combined for payment and shipping if they are from the same Goodwill location, close within 7 days of each other, are not marked as Cannot Be Combined For Shipping, do not exceed 20 lbs in combined weight and are being shipped via the same carrier.
To combine eligible auction items into one order, you must wait until all of the items have ended before paying.
Once the auctions have ended, please sign into your ShopGoodwill.com account and proceed to your Open Orders. Click on the Pay link next to one of the items, all auction items that may be eligible for combination will then be displayed. Click on the box next to each item and follow the instructions to complete your payment.
Once payment has been made for an item, it cannot be combined with another item won at a later date. If you have won an item and expect to win another from the same seller and wish to combine all items, you must postpone payment until you have won the second item (third, fourth item, etc.) but not exceeding 7 days from the closing date of the first item.
Due to the fragility and size and/or weight of certain items, the seller may not offer combined shipping for certain items. Please be sure to read all item descriptions carefully for any other item combination restrictions.
Items that have been paid for will be shipped to the address on file and will not be able to be modified or combined. Address changes, shipping cost adjustments, and/or alternative packaging requests MUST be submitted prior to payment. PO Boxes can be added to your profile address if one of our shipping carriers does not deliver to your physical address. We cannot edit profiles; please be sure this is done prior to making any purchases. Alternative packaging requests are subject to an additional fee where applicable.
In the event of an unclaimed pickup order, or a returned package, the customer will need to pay an additional shipping charge to re-ship the order. Under NO circumstances will a refund be given for said unclaimed/returned packages.
Any and all changes/adjustments MUST be made PRIOR to payment! Adjustments WILL NOT be made after a payment has been submitted. This location is closed on weekends & holidays. We may not be able to get to your support ticket right away. Please plan in advance.

shipping.policy:
We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called
dimensional weight
and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight. For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit:
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.
Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays.
Goodwill Industries of the Inland Northwest will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.
Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, please provide us with a physical address.
Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.
Combined shipping
Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:
The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
Items can't be purchased via buy-it-now or with 1 cent shipping.
You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.

Right piece: 2x1.25x1 inches

Ideal for mineral collectors, educational purposes, or lapidary projects.

description:
This lot contains approximately 30+ raw mineral and rock specimens suitable for collectors and educational purposes. The collection includes various types of quartz crystals, calcite clusters, and other mineral formations. The specimens feature a range of colors including clear, white, gray, brown, green, and yellow. Most pieces are unpolished and display natural surfaces with crystal terminations, druse, and matrix formations visible on many specimens. The stones vary in size and shape. The collection is in good used condition with minor natural imperfections typical of raw mineral specimens. Pieces are suitable for display, study, or lapidary use.
11 Pounds.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 55 Transposition Insulator (CD 205)
Pressed Glass, Aqua Blue, Vintage Early to Mid-20th Century
Vintage Hemingray No. 55 CD 205 aqua glass transposition insulator, historically utilized on rural telephone and power transmission lines to rotate and swap wire positions to minimize electrical crosstalk interference. Manufactured in Muncie, Indiana, this distinctive style of American industrial glass remains a popular favorite among telegraph, utility, and antique glass collectors.
Distinctive transposition profile featuring spiral wire guide channels across the upper dome
Pressed aqua blue glass containing natural manufacturing swirl patterns and authentic seed air bubbles
Embossed "HEMINGRAY" on the front skirt and "N 55" on the reverse skirt, featuring a smooth base rim
Measures approximately 4 inches in diameter by 4 inches in height
Condition:
Embossed lettering remains crisp and well-defined. Glass exhibits brilliant gloss with typical factory mold seams and minor light surface contact marks consistent with authentic utility use. A minor fleabite flake is present on the edge of the interior skirt rim. Free of major cracks, repairs, or structural breaks.

description: This listing is for a natural stibnite (stibnite, also known as antimony) raw mineral specimen. The specimen features metallic gray, elongated bladed crystals radiating in a fan-like cluster with a bright silver sheen and some darker tarnished areas. Small whitish and grayish matrix or secondary mineral deposits are visible among the crystals. It measures approximately 2.5 x 2 x 1.75 inches and weighs about 95.4 grams as shown on a digital scale. Please note that stibnite is a naturally brittle and delicate material, so some flaking or shedding of crystals is possible. Suitable for geological and mineral collectors.
